whenToUse: Picking or dropping files with progress, retry and cancel: documents, imports, attachments.
Forms that require one or more files with type and size limits.
avoidWhen: A single image with crop and focal point — use Image field.
Choosing from existing files — use Media picker.
a11y: The drop target is a real button with the same keyboard path as the pointer.
Accepted types and size limits are stated in text; errors are announced per file.
